sections.changelog:
Added

  • **Category filter gains an include (whitelist) mode and a root-flatten option.** The Categories tab now offers a filter mode: "Exclude ticked" keeps the original behaviour (import everything except the ticked branches), while "Include ticked only" imports just the ticked branches and drops the rest. Each branch also has an optional "lift children to top" box: when set, the wrapper category itself is not created as a term and its direct children become top-level categories, with the rest of the branch keeping its hierarchy. This lets a supplier feed that nests everything under top-level wrappers (e.g. "Для выгрузки" / "Не выгружать") be imported as just the contents of one wrapper, without that wrapper appearing in the catalogue.

Changed

  • **Category names are no longer overwritten from the feed on re-import.** A category's name is set once when its term is first created and then left alone, so renaming a category on your own site sticks across imports even though the supplier feed keeps the original label. The external-id binding still prevents duplicates regardless of the displayed name, and the category's parent (hierarchy position) is still synced from the feed.
